item.title: Nigeria Sets Up New Military Command To Slow Spread Of Islamic Militants After Deadly Attack
item.description: By OPE ADETAYO Associated Press LAGOS, Nigeria (AP) — The Nigerian government has announced a new military operation to tackle Islamic militants following the killing of more than 160 people in western Kwara state, many of them reportedly for resisting extremist ideology. item.title: Savannah Guthrie’s Missing Mother Is ‘Still Out There,’ Sheriff Says, But No Suspects
item.description: By SEJAL GOVINDARAO and JACQUES BILLEAUD Associated Press TUCSON, Ariz. (AP) — Investigators believe the missing mother of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie is “still out there,” but they have not identified any suspects, a sheriff in Arizona said Thursday. item.title: Abortion Pill Suit
item.description: A newly-passed Texas law, allowing for civil lawsuits against abortion pill providers, is being tested for the first time in the courts. A Galveston man is suing the California doctor who sent medication to his girlfriend, ending her pregnancy. John Seago with Texas Right To Life says the goal is not to sue one or two doctors. It’s to send the message that, if you mail abortion pills to Texas, you will be held accountable.

item.title: Help For Cops
item.description: Big events like this weekend’s Super Bowl require a lot of security. Congressman Tony Gonzales has filed legislation that makes it easier for elite Border Patrol teams to help local cops handle things like mass shootings or acts of terrorism. He says they are trained and equipped to conduct high-risk operations. In Texas, they were involved in stopping both the El Paso Walmart shooting and the deadly attack on Robb Elementary in Uvalde.

item.title: ICE Buys Warehouse
item.description: The feds have confirmed that they bought a warehouse near downtown San Antonio to be used as an immigration detention facility. The selling price was just over 66-million dollars. ICE says it will be renovated make it “well structured,” as a way to keep “criminals off American streets.” The cash, they say, came from the One Big Beautiful Bill. They did not release a timeline.

item.title: Beef Prices Rising
item.description: A new report shows the nation’s supply of beef cows is dropping more than predicted. And, with fewer cattle comes higher prices for consumers. David Anderson at Texas A&M says that a months-long drought is being blamed for the decline. It affects rancher’s ability to expand.
